import json, random, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/app')
from test_diff import make_solvable, rand_request
from main import solve

rng = random.Random(999)
lines = []
# 60 solvable 10-txn, all fully overlapping (no precedence help)
for _ in range(60):
    r = make_solvable(rng, 10)
    for t in r['transactions']:
        t['start'] = 0; t['end'] = 100
    lines.append(r)
# 30 random 10-txn (mostly unsat)
for _ in range(30):
    r = rand_request(rng, 10)
    for t in r['transactions']:
        t['start'] = 0; t['end'] = 100
    lines.append(r)
# adversarial: 10 txns, each cas on 6 shared keys, unsat final
adv = {'initial': {}, 'final': {k: 9 for k in 'abcdef'}, 'transactions': []}
for i in range(10):
    ops = []
    for k in 'abcdef':
        ops.append(['cas', k, rng.choice([None,0,1]), rng.randint(-3,3), rng.choice([True,False])])
        ops.append(['scan', '', 'zz', []])
    adv['transactions'].append({'id': f't{i}', 'start': 0, 'end': 100, 'ops': ops[:5]})
lines.append(adv)

data = ''.join(json.dumps(r) + '\n' for r in lines)
t0 = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '/app/main.py'], input=data, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=55)
dt = time.time() - t0
assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr
out = p.stdout.splitlines()
assert len(out) == len(lines), (len(out), len(lines))
sat = sum(1 for l in out if json.loads(l)['order'] is not None)
print(f'{len(lines)} requests in {dt:.2f}s, {sat} satisfiable, rc=0')

import json, random, subprocess, sys, time

    txns = []
    for i in range(10):
        ops = []
        for _ in range(5):
            k = rng.choice(keys)
            if rng.random() < 0.25:
                ops.append(['del', k])

                ops.append(['put', k, rng.randint(0, 3)])
        txns.append({'id': f't{i}', 'start': 0, 'end': 100, 'ops': ops})
    # unreachable final (value 7 never written, absent from initial)
    r = {'initial': {}, 'final': {'a': 7}, 'transactions': txns}
    lines.append(r)
data = ''.join(json.dumps(r) + '\n' for r in lines)
t0 = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '/app/main.py'], input=data, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=58)
dt = time.time() - t0
print('rc', p.returncode, 'time %.2fs' % dt)
print(p.stdout)
if p.stderr: print('stderr:', p.stderr[:500])
